tools_helpful.evidence: R3-R5: bootstrap scaffolded the project, copied source, injected TODO[migrate-NNN] anchors and pre-seeded MIGRATION-MAPPING.md/MIGRATION-DEFERRED.md; agent followed it without friction.
R6: fetched the threading pattern to resolve the Dispatcher.RunAsync TODOs in the three SEQUENTIAL scenario files.
R15: validation reported PASS; gated the final build/handoff.

tools_problematic.problem: Emitted a spurious '[WARN] MIGRATION-DEFERRED.md exists with content but mapping has no defer rows' even though nothing was deferred (the legitimate zero-deferral case).
tools_problematic.evidence: R15-R16: agent spent two turns opening MIGRATION-DEFERRED.md to confirm the WARN was benign before proceeding.

tool_limitations.limitation: Its 'no defer rows' branch only treats the deferred file as clean when its text contains the literal phrase 'No items deferred', but Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 seeds a '| (none) | — |' placeholder row, so the two never agree on the empty case.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Recognize the bootstrap's '(none)' placeholder as the canonical empty state (and have the bootstrap also print the literal phrase) so a zero-deferral migration validates without a WARN.

special_apis.special_handling: Triaged SEQUENTIAL by the bootstrap (sensitive capture namespace); resolved via the threading anchor for Dispatcher.RunAsync. Migrated as-is; runtime ERROR text ('No Video Device Id found') matches the UWP golden.

errors_encountered.error: Broken Scenario file with a duplicate class/namespace block after a single edit
errors_encountered.root_cause: Agent attempted a whole-file rewrite with one edit whose old_str matched only the file header/using block, so the original class body remained appended after the new content.
errors_encountered.fix: R12-R14: agent re-viewed the file and removed the duplicated tail (lines 233-439) in a follow-up edit.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Spurious MIGRATION-DEFERRED.md WARN on a zero-deferral migration
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: 2 turns spent confirming the WARN was benign
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Producer/validator phrase mismatch: bootstrap seeds '(none)' placeholder; validator only accepts literal 'No items deferred'.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Agent manually inspected the file, judged the WARN benign, proceeded.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Aligning Validate-UwpMigration.ps1 and Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 on the empty-deferred sentinel so the WARN never fires when nothing was deferred.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Several planning turns to reconstruct the SDK-sample shell (MainPage.Current, NotifyUser/NotifyType, SampleConfiguration partial MainPage, App.xaml SampleHeader/ScenarioDescription styles) and consolidate the SDKTemplate namespace into the app namespace.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: SKILL.md's Shell-conversion table names the 'MainPage + ListView + Frame (SDK-sample idiom)' row but does not enumerate the SDKTemplate helper scaffolding that every Windows-universal-sample carries, so the agent reverse-engineered it from source.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Agent reimplemented the shell helpers and changed namespace SDKTemplate -> CameraProfile.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Adding a short note under the existing SDK-sample shell row listing the SDKTemplate helpers to recreate and the namespace consolidation.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Duplicate class/namespace after a partial edit
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Single edit with old_str matching only the header left the old class body duplicated.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Removed the duplicate tail in a follow-up edit.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: General editing discipline (replace the whole file when rewriting wholesale) — not migration-specific; capable re-run avoids it.
